title: Normalize display-name whitespace
prompt: Read README.md and AGENTS.md. Implement normalize_name(name: str) -> str in demo/text.py. Trim leading/trailing whitespace and collapse every internal run of whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) to one ordinary space. Preserve case and Unicode characters. Empty and whitespace-only strings produce an empty string. Inputs are strings; no extra validation or dependencies. Add tests in tests/test_text.py and run the full suite. Do not edit the other task or shared files.
acceptance: normalize_name('  Ana   López ') returns 'Ana López'; tabs/newlines are normalized too.
Empty and whitespace-only inputs return an empty string; case and Unicode are preserved.
Meaningful regression tests and all project checks pass.
